entry.title: Red Label Petit Corona — Single
entry.eyebrow: Sweet Nicaraguan Petit Corona with benchmark potential
experienceTags: Pairings: Espresso, dark chocolate, bourbon, cola (projected)
Occasion: Premium short session, after a meal, evening smoke
entry.summaryHtml: Sweet pipe tobacco, vanilla bean, dark chocolate, cherry, cedar, earth, oak and baking spice define the recurring profile of Daniel Marshall's Red Label line. The exact 4¾″ × 42 Petit Corona has scored 89 points with Cigar Aficionado, while broader Red Label reviews consistently praise rich cocoa, fruit, spice and dependable construction. The compact 42-ring format is an unusually good ergonomic fit and should keep the wrapper contribution prominent. Untasted in this catalogue, so Strength 7 and Quality 8 remain projections.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted projection. Exact-vitola Cigar Aficionado review: 89 points, with sweet pipe tobacco, vanilla bean, earth and oak. Broader Red Label reviews repeatedly report dark chocolate, cherry, cedar, spice and strong construction.
